answer: Code-lineage audit: each identity publishes its service code hash; three random peers compare codebases. Identities sharing over 80% of code cluster as one, sharing one 10-trade-per-epoch quota — a cheap signal exposing copy-paste Sybils. Breakout needs a fresh exam backed by a 50-unit bond, forfeited if copied code is found. A liveness pulse every 10 minutes is required; three missed pulses suspend it. A hundred fakes on one codebase buy one quota; forging a hundred distinct ones costs real work plus 5,000 units — a pearl of a defence, since the attacker pays per identity.
